structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and put the 750 ₪ a month into the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund. The page says I'd have about 179,889 ₪ after 15 years, in today's money, after fees and tax. It assumes 2% inflation a year. Fairly sure.

stuck.why: The big card shows 179,889 ₪ but not where the money sits. I had to scroll down to find out it's פסגות and the ילין לפידות fund.
I couldn't tell what inflation it used until I tapped the 'אינפלציה' button. The rate is only inside that popup.

findings.what: The main result card doesn't say which bank or fund it's for. You have to scroll to find out it's פסגות + ילין לפידות.
The inflation rate (2%) is hidden behind a button. The main line only says 'בכסף של היום'.
The cheapest and second-cheapest are almost the same (−122 ₪ over 15 years), so 'choose the pair' feels pointless and confusing
I had to guess which cost the big pink bar is from the legend colours. The bar itself has no label.
I typed 750 but the slider shows 800, which made me unsure which value it used
